purpose: Test whether a style-only LoRA improves held-out scene style without treating garment transfer, pose control, or character identity as the same task.
hypothesis: With the same held-out prompt and seed, the LoRA-on output reproduces the approved restrained webtoon rendering traits more consistently than LoRA-off, without copying a training scene or collapsing the requested camera and setting.
non_goals: Precise jacket, crop-top, bag, or footwear transfer; those remain VTON or prop-reference tests.
Exact pose or camera reconstruction; those remain ControlNet or scene-generation tests.
Character-identity training; it is a later independent experiment with a separate approved dataset.

base_model.reason: The model is already cached. A previous narrow UNet-only LoRA run completed at 384x512 with bf16 and a 6,556 MiB observed peak, so this is an 8 GB feasibility baseline rather than a production-model endorsement.

data_contract.asset_origin: Human-approved, locally generated P7-5.1 background-only style references with documented reuse permission.
forbidden_inputs: Mira face, turnaround, full-body, prop, or VTON outputs
unapproved candidates, failed generations, crops, duplicates, and near-duplicate scene variants
held-out scenes in the train directory or caption file
data_contract.caption_rule: Every English tag-style caption begins with the shared trigger p7style and then describes only scene, camera, lighting, and rendering traits. It must not name Mira, an outfit, a bag, a face, or a fixed pose.
data_contract.split_rule: Each item has an immutable source_id, SHA-256, approval record, caption, and split. Train and held-out SHA-256 values must be disjoint. Held-out scene, camera, and lighting combinations must not duplicate a train item.

training_conditions.trainable_modules: UNet attention LoRA only; VAE and both text encoders frozen

pilot.purpose: Verify the environment, data manifest, checkpoint save, and memory limit only; it cannot pass the style-quality gate.

result.data: Nine approved background references repeated for the runtime pilot; this is not the 16/4 quality dataset.
result.memory_strategy: Precompute frozen text-encoder and VAE representations, keep them on CPU, then place only the trainable UNet LoRA path on GPU.
result.first_attempt: fail: moving both text encoders onto GPU while the UNet was resident exhausted the 8 GB device.

main.purpose: Choose one checkpoint by held-out comparison rather than by final training loss.

result.dataset: 16 human-approved training backgrounds and 4 human-approved held-out backgrounds

revised_pilot.reason_for_revision: The initial comparison used a bf16 standard pipeline and natural-language captions, whereas the model card specifies fp16, tag-oriented prompting, Euler Ancestral sampling, and 28 steps.

rejected_variant.result: loss became NaN at step 50 and remained NaN through step 100

inference_probe.result: The requested place remained readable, but the output stayed close to the base model's dark photoreal-anime rendering and did not visibly acquire the approved restrained webtoon rendering traits.
inference_probe.decision: Do not promote this adapter or run the full held-out grid. Treat a different base model or a larger style dataset as a new experiment.

sdxl_base_pilot.hypothesis: A general SDXL base that already follows the project’s natural-language background contract will preserve held-out place prompts better than the anime-specialized base while a small LoRA adds restrained watercolor-webtoon rendering.

heldout_screen.assistant_visual_observation: All four requested place categories remained readable. The LoRA-on outputs showed stronger watercolor texture and softer color blending, but some compositions changed materially.
heldout_screen.decision: Do not select the adapter yet. Obtain human pass, partial, or fail judgments for style, content, generalization, and boundary before testing other scales or extending training.

heldout_evaluation.comparison_rule: For every held-out prompt and seed, generate LoRA-off and each LoRA-on scale with the same base model, resolution, scheduler, step count, negative prompt, and seed. The LoRA-off baseline omits the learned p7style trigger because that token has no base-model meaning; record this prompt difference explicitly.
human_gates: style: restrained webtoon line handling, low-saturation flat colors, and approved rendering character are visible
content: the requested held-out place, lighting, and camera remain readable
generalization: no copied training background, recurring object template, or collapsed camera
boundary: no claim about Mira identity or exact clothing transfer
heldout_evaluation.pass_rule: At least three of four held-out prompts improve the style gate at one fixed scale, every selected output keeps its requested scene and camera, and no selected output resembles a training scene closely enough to be judged memorized. Human review records pass, partial, or fail per gate.

failure_actions.oom_or_unstable_loss: Stop before quality tuning; record peak VRAM, runtime, and the failing stage, then reduce only one memory variable in a fresh pilot.
failure_actions.style_gain_but_scene_collapse: Reject the checkpoint; inspect caption specificity and train-scene diversity before changing rank or learning rate.
failure_actions.no_heldout_style_gain: Reject the trial; do not merge the adapter into a VTON or inpaint path.
failure_actions.pass: Keep the adapter as a style-only candidate. A character-only LoRA and any VTON-plus-LoRA composition require new, independent experiments.
